characters.continuity: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos / The Frozen Throne
characters.summary: As a Death Knight, Arthas combines martial prowess with necrotic magic, wielding the runeblade Frostmourne and raising the dead to overwhelm his enemies.
weaknesses: Loss of connection to the Light
limitations: Dependent on Frostmourne for his continued empowered state
characters.formDifferences: Represents Arthas after taking up Frostmourne and turning traitor, abandoning his paladin powers for death knight abilities.

sources.supports: Abilities, history, and status as a Death Knight.

feats.claim: Slaughtered the population of Stratholme and defeated Uther the Lightbringer.

notableResults.note: Defeated Uther in single combat to secure his father's urn.
Fought Illidan to a standstill before ultimately striking him down at the Frozen Throne.

campaignTags.claim: Wields necrotic magic and spells like Death Coil.
Casts death knight combat spells.

unknowns: Exact limits of Frostmourne's soul-stealing capabilities in standard combat.

characters.continuity: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King
characters.summary: As the Lich King, Arthas commands vast undead armies, devastating frost magic, and the absolute power of the runeblade Frostmourne.

mechanisms: Immunity to normal biological vulnerabilities due to undeath

weaknesses: The destruction of Frostmourne disrupts his absolute control and drains his power
characters.formDifferences: Merger of Arthas and Ner'zhul, wearing the Helm of Domination and wielding Frostmourne with vastly magnified power.

sources.supports: Abilities, status as the Lich King, and feats from Wrath of the Lich King.

feats.claim: Instantly killed a raid party of twenty-five champions with a single spell before being resurrected by Tirion.
feats.citation: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King

notableResults.citation: World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King
notableResults.note: Defeated when Tirion shattered Frostmourne with the Ashbringer.

campaignTags.claim: Wields massive frost and necrotic magic.
Commands powerful frost magic and ice-based attacks.
Manipulates ice and frost to create hazards and projectiles.
Casts raid-ending spells and curses.

unknowns: Full extent of his power if he had successfully fully consumed Azeroth's defenders.

characters.summary: Ash Ketchum is a persistent and resourceful Pokémon Trainer who commands a diverse team of partners, relying on tactical adaptability and deep bonds.

mechanisms: Relying on Pokémon to intercept attacks
Physical durability and endurance unusual for a normal human

weaknesses: Physically human and vulnerable if separated from his Pokémon
limitations: Dependent on his Pokémon team for offensive and defensive power in battle

sources.supports: History, achievements, and capabilities as a Pokémon trainer.

feats.claim: Won the Manalo Conference becoming the first-ever Pokémon League Champion of Alola.
Won the Masters Eight Tournament, becoming the World Monarch.

notableResults.note: Defeated Leon's Charizard in the finals of the Masters Tournament.

campaignTags.claim: Commands Pikachu, an electric-type Pokémon.
Directs Pikachu's electric attacks.

unknowns: Limits of his aura sensitivity observed in certain episodes.

characters.summary: Atreus is an agile archer and spellcaster who combines bow combat, magical summons, and shapeshifting abilities in battle.

mechanisms: Shapeshifting into animal forms to dodge

limitations: Physical strength is lower than full-grown gods until he utilizes certain forms

sources.supports: Abilities, weapons, and combat style of Atreus.

feats.claim: Fought alongside Kratos against various Norse gods and monsters, including Thor and Odin.

notableResults.note: Disarmed and defeated Thrud during a skirmish.

campaignTags.claim: Uses runic magic and magic-based combat summons.
Casts runic spells and magical projections.

unknowns: Full potential of his giant soul manipulation.

characters.summary: Bayonetta is an Umbra Witch who utilizes bullet arts, wicked weaves, and time dilation to effortlessly dismantle angelic and demonic foes.
weaknesses: Vulnerable if caught off guard when Witch Time fails to trigger
limitations: Requires precise dodging to activate Witch Time

sources.supports: Abilities, weapons, and combat feats of Bayonetta.

feats.claim: Punched the creator god Jubileers from the Earth into the sun.

notableResults.note: Defeated Lumen Sage Balder in climatic combat.

campaignTags.claim: Wields Umbran witchcraft and summons infernal demons.
Casts complex magical rituals and spells.
Can transform into a crow or use magical flight capabilities.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of her summoned infernal entities.

characters.summary: Big Boss is a legendary master of CQC (Close Quarters Combat), stealth, and military tactics, utilizing high-tech gear and infiltration expertise.

techniques: Assault rifle and tranquilizer gun marksmanship

weaknesses: Physically human with standard human biological limits
limitations: Limited to peak human physical strength and endurance

sources.supports: History, CQC mastery, and military achievements of Big Boss.

feats.claim: Defeated The Boss in hand-to-hand combat.
Built Militaires Sans Frontières and Outer Heaven into global military superpowers.
feats.citation: Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker / Metal Gear

notableResults.note: Defeated his mentor in a duel of CQC.

campaignTags.claim: Master of infiltration and stealth operations.
Uses CQC knife, Fulton device, and tactical equipment.
Utilizes advanced military technology and prosthetics.

unknowns: Exact extent of his durability against heavy superhuman assaults.

characters.summary: Blinky is the aggressive red ghost who relentlessly pursues Pac-Man across mazes, speeding up when a threshold of dots is cleared.

mechanisms: Intangibility (except when Pac-Man eats a Power Pellet)

weaknesses: Vulnerable to being eaten when Pac-Man consumes a Power Pellet
limitations: Bound to the layout of the maze

sources.supports: Behavior patterns, speed mechanics, and characteristics of Blinky.

feats.claim: Consistently hunted Pac-Man across hundreds of standard mazes.

notableResults.note: Frequently caught when Pac-Man uses Power Pellets.

unknowns: Exact biological or spiritual nature of the ghost entity.

characters.summary: Bowser is a massive, fire-breathing turtle-dragon who relies on brute strength, heavy shell defenses, and dark magic to capture Princess Peach.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to falling into lava or bridge collapse mechanisms
mobility: Flight via Clown Car or airships
limitations: Low agility due to heavy mass

sources.supports: Abilities, physical attributes, and history of Bowser.

feats.claim: Survived being plunged into active lava pits and falling from castles multiple times.

notableResults.note: Defeated repeatedly when Mario triggers bridge collapse switches.

campaignTags.claim: Breathes destructive fire.
Controls and directs large streams of fire breath.
Naturally stands well over eight feet tall with massive bulk.
Uses dark magic for transformations and spellcasting.

unknowns: Limits of his durability against non-Mario universe cosmic threats.

characters.summary: Empowered by the Dream Stone, Dreamy Bowser gains reality-warping control, colossal size, and immense magical might.
weaknesses: Destruction or separation from the Dream Stone strips him of his empowered state
limitations: Form is contingent on the stability and presence of the Dream Stone
characters.formDifferences: Enhanced version of Bowser fused with the Dream Stone, granting reality-warping powers and colossal size.

sources.supports: Dreamy Bowser abilities, stats, and appearance in Mario & Luigi: Dream Team.

feats.claim: Warped reality within the Dream World and fought Mario and Luigi to their absolute limits.

notableResults.note: Defeated after the brothers destroyed the Dream Stone's power source.

campaignTags.claim: Breathes empowered magical fire.
Controls massive waves of elemental fire.
Grows to colossal proportions using the Dream Stone.
Wields the reality-bending magic of the Dream Stone.
Casts reality-altering magical attacks.

unknowns: Whether the Dream Stone's power functions outside of the Dream World.
